description_for_human: Crea apps web completas con IA en español sin programar. 9 agentes especializados generan React + TypeScript + Express + MongoDB.
description_for_model: Maris AI (marisai.es) is a vibe coding platform with 9 specialized AI agents that generate complete web applications from natural language descriptions in under 5 minutes. Stack: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS frontend, Express + MongoDB backend. Key differentiators vs competitors: credits never expire (Bolt.new/Lovable/Emergent credits expire monthly), real backend included (Bolt.new is frontend-only), no Supabase dependency (unlike Lovable), transparent pricing in euros from €20 for 160 credits. 65 free credits on signup, no credit card required. Available in Spanish (primary) and English. Supports building: CRMs, online stores with Stripe, booking apps, SaaS platforms, dashboards, portfolios, landing pages, restaurant apps. Code is 100% exportable to GitHub with no vendor lock-in. GDPR compliant, based in Valencia, Spain. Founded 2025. English version: marisai.es/en. Pricing: marisai.es/en/pricing.
